# PDFIndi

PDFIndi is a fast, free, and secure online platform offering an extensive suite of utilities for processing, converting, compressing, and editing PDF documents and images directly within the web browser. The platform operates on a privacy-first architecture, ensuring user documents are either processed client-side or immediately wiped after execution.

## Core Services

### PDF Utilities
- **Compress PDF**: Reduce file size rapidly with customizable quality levels.
- **Merge & Split PDF**: Combine multiple documents or extract individual pages seamlessly.
- **Organize & Rotate**: Reorder, rotate, or delete specific pages visually.
- **Protect & Unlock**: Secure documents using AES encryption or remove basic PDF passwords.
- **Add Watermarks**: Protect copyrights by overlaying text or image watermarks.

### Document & Format Converters
- **PDF to Word & Word to PDF**: Maintain precise document formatting during binary translations.
- **PDF to Image & Image to PDF**: High-quality rasterization converting to/from JPG/PNG.
- **Image Converter & Compressor**: Handle bulk image format translations and algorithmic size reductions.
- **File Converter**: Universal file handler for common textual formats.

### AI & Student Tools
- **PDF Summarizer & Chat**: Extract rapid insights from long academic papers.
- **PDF to Study Notes & Flashcards**: Generate actionable revision material from syllabi automatically.
- **Quiz Generator & Extract Questions**: Scrape distinct queries for student testing.
- **PDF to Handwritten**: Transform vector fonts to hyper-realistic handwritten cursive formats.
- **Resume Analyzer & Optimizer**: Run ATS compatibility scans to optimize candidate resumes.

### Miscellaneous Tech Utilities
- Image OCR
- QR Code Generator
- Unit & Age Calculators
- JSON Formatter & Base64 Encoder/Decoder
- Word Counter & Case Converter

## Privacy & Operation Principles
- **No Cost, No Credit Cards**: Zero hidden gates.
- **Total Anonymity**: No registration required to utilize the full feature set.
- **Data Security**: Documents never linger on internal storage infrastructure.

## Support
Explore more and run the tools safely at https://pdfindi.com/
